meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你给的工件(代码、配置、提示词等)当作优化对象,围绕你设定的目标自动开展多轮实验:提出改进假设、在隔离环境里测试、记录哪些有效哪些无效,并只采纳通过测试验证的改进。最终给你改进后的最佳工件和一份尝试过程报告。
howto.when: 当你想多轮实验迭代改进某个工件(如代码、模型、管道)并避免过拟合时触发,例如提升评估分数、改进智能体、优化管道。即使没提Arbor,描述反复实验-评估循环、竞争想法或开发/测试差距也会触发。

say.text: 用Arbor把我的模型在开发集上的准确率从60%提高到70%,用测试集做验证
say.note: Claude会初始化任务元组并开始迭代循环

say.text: 用这个技能优化我的数据清理管道,目标是减少后续模型的损失
say.note: 会为管道建立开发/测试评估器

say.text: 对我的智能体框架做多轮改进,防止过拟合开发集,每次实验记录假设
say.note: 每个假设会被记录到假设树中

howto.what_en: Claude treats your artifact as the optimization target, runs repeated experiment-evaluate cycles, tests hypotheses in isolation, merges only test-validated changes, and returns the best improved version and a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user wants to iteratively improve an artifact without overfitting. Also triggers on repeated experiment-evaluate loops or dev/test gap worries, even without saying 'Arbor'.

say_en.text: Use Arbor to raise my model's dev accuracy from 60% to 70%, test-validated.
say_en.note: Claude sets up the task tuple and starts the loop.

say_en.text: Optimize my data-cleaning pipeline to reduce downstream model loss.
say_en.note: It sets up dev/test evaluators for the pipeline.

say_en.text: Improve my agent harness over rounds, avoid dev overfit; log each hypothesis.
say_en.note: Each hypothesis is recorded in the hypothesis tree.
